name: Ashen Coast
apply: Call applyAshenPatch(world, patch) on the coast world right after the 'coast' scene is built (carve + mirror + dress), before it is returned/cached. See apply_ashen_patch.js.
schema: Every prop object uses the live world.props schema {kind,x,y,style?,w?,d?,rotY?,looted?,label?}; tiles = metres; x -> three.js x, y -> three.js z; rotY radians (added to world_props yaw). Collision uses the existing engine paths only: tile solid (world.solid) and softProp boxes (w/d on the prop, else $D[kind]).
requires: handoff/game_engineer/ashen/world_props.ashen_additions.json merged at runtime into the loaded models/props_new/world_props.json table (add_kinds -> kinds; body_add_styles -> kinds.body.styles). Live file is not replaced.
